champion.tips: GRAGAS TIPS AND TRICKS Gragas is an early game dominant laner. Try and trade as frequently as possible whenever the enemy walks forward to last hit. Throw your Ultimate R just behind the enemy to ensure they get knocked forward. Placing it on top of them may knock them in the wrong direction. Staying off to the side while your team groups can allow you to flank the enemy and knock them into your teammates.
champion.builds: THE BEST GRAGAS BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Gragas Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Phase Rush as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Rod of Ages as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Winter's Approach. For your last 3 items, you should build Cosmic Drive, Zhonya's Hourglass and finish with Shadowflame. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 51.5% winrate over 3 170 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Grasp of the Undying as your keystone, Demolish, Second Wind and Overgrowth in the primary tree, and Manaflow Band with Scorch in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Rod of Ages as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Winter's Approach as a third item. You want to finish the build with Cosmic Drive, Zhonya's Hourglass and Randuin's Omen. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 51.6% win rate across 750 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Gragas Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Arcane Comet, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch as your primary rune tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Rod of Ages as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Archangel's Staff as third item. The last 3 options are Cosmic Drive, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 50.5% win rate over 586 matches played. Situational Gragas Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Gragas build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Gragas runes page.
